Prerequisite: 20+ Cursed Energy score, 15th level, Breakthrough

Your cursed energy manipulation is some of the best that the world has ever seen, it must take at least a couple of centuries for another person such as yourself to be born once again. You gain the following benefits:

  • If a feature deals damage you can reroll all 1s and 2s on damage dice. Once per long rest you can deal maximum damage on a technique you use. This does not include ordinary attacks from you or shikigami.

  • Once per long rest, you can use one feature that requires Cursed Energy. The cost of that feature is lowered to 0 for that use, if a feature depends on how much Cursed Energy you spend, it counts as if you used the maximum required. For example, Reverse Cursed Technique would heal 50 with a modifier of +5.
